bullets.text: Telco AI Startups Surge - **Telco AI** market projected to grow from $2.66 billion to $50.21 billion by 2034.
Diverging 5G Strategies - **AT&T**, **Verizon**, and **T-Mobile** adopt distinct approaches to 5G infrastructure.
HCLTech Acquires HPE Unit - **HCLTech** aims for AI-driven growth with the acquisition of **HPE's** Telco Solutions business.
AI and Wi-Fi Convergence - The intersection of **AI** and **Wi-Fi** will dominate technological advancements in 2026.
6G's Intelligent Shift - **6G** will embed intelligence directly into the radio layer, transforming network operations.
Huawei's Agentic AI Vision - **Huawei** promotes AI agents as key to operational efficiency and new revenue streams.
Geospatial Analytics Revolution - **Geospatial** data is reshaping network planning and customer insights in telecom.
AI Infrastructure Predictions - By 2026, intelligent network design will be crucial for AI performance and security.
Mobile Core's Dynamic Future - **AI**, edge access, and disaster protection will shape the mobile core in 2026.
